historical_reviews.deepseek: Identifies the intended cold power transition and count, but does not safely bind the target or distinguish chassis DC control from AC-feed manipulation and cannot prove each recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains conditional automation with a 25-cycle power/boot ledger and complete BMC/OS/device evidence.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Repeated chassis power changes are user-confirmed and non-retrying; the agent may orchestrate only an approved control path and cannot own the final DUT verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT survives 25 cold chassis power-off/on transitions, boots completely each time, retains all expected devices and shows no prohibited BMC/OS error, hang or blue screen.
original_method: After target and chassis-control binding, preserve baseline evidence and use an approved BMC power interface for exactly 25 off/on cycles with explicit dwell; record command completion, actual chassis state, boot/readiness, complete inventory and event evidence at every cycle.
manual_activity: The owner authorizes 25 cold interruptions and supplies off/on timing, workload and safe final state; an operator supervises the disruptive sequence and keeps independent recovery access.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, BMC, chassis-power domain and expected populated inventory
Supported BMC/IPMI/Redfish cold off/on operation and privilege scope
Protected credential path without process-list exposure
Off dwell, power-state confirmation, on-to-boot readiness timeout and cycle counter
Dedicated window, active workload drain, storage policy and final state
Independent console/OOB recovery and stop thresholds
safety_requirements: Export the complete BMC/SEL/OS/device baseline before any approved clear
Never place passwords in command arguments or evidence
Confirm the command affects only the intended chassis power domain and not an AC feed
Verify actual off state and approved dwell before every on request
Stop on transition mismatch, boot timeout, hang, blue screen, thermal/power alarm, device loss, persistent error or evidence gap
Never escalate to forced AC or PSU action and never auto-retry
Close in the approved power state
agent_execution_scope: Validate SUT/BMC identity, chassis-control semantics and inventory
Capture baseline and initialize the 25-cycle power ledger
After approval, issue only the supported cold off/on requests
At each cycle verify off/on state, boot identity, OS readiness, device inventory and complete BMC/OS events
Abort and preserve the first anomaly without alternate power action
Compare final state and report facts without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the cold DC control, timing, workload impact and recovery plan
Supervise the 25-cycle disruption and handle exceptional recovery
Authorize any log clear or forced intervention separately
Review complete evidence and decide PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: BMC power off/on is a plausible cold-cycle primitive, but the exact target/interface is unbound, credentials are exposed via `-P`, no state/dwell gate separates commands and a final SEL tail does not validate 25 recoveries.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported protected chassis-power interface only after target binding; require observed off state, approved dwell, observed on/boot readiness and full evidence before advancing each cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exactly 25 cold reboots, the fully populated CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network configuration, 30/180-minute estimates and every source criterion remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the chassis power domain, preserve baseline, perform 25 state-verified off/dwell/on/ready transitions, halt on the first discrepancy and compare final health against the starting inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes cold/DC semantics explicit and adds observed state, dwell, protected secrets, complete per-cycle audit and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS warm restart and physical AC removal are different stimuli; neither can silently substitute for chassis cold power-off/on coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold shutdown can interrupt writes and expose storage, firmware, boot and device-enumeration faults; a wrong power target affects the entire SUT.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define `Cold Reboot` for this platform. If only a reset command is available, or if the private dc-cycle script manipulates a different rail/domain, the variance and uncovered off-state coverage must be explicit.
expected_evidence: Approved SUT/BMC/chassis power identity, control method, inventory, timing, window and abort matrix
Immutable pre-clear BMC/SEL/OS/device/sensor/storage baseline plus authorized clear record
Cycles 1-25 ledger with request status, observed off/on states, dwell, boot and readiness timestamps
Complete per-cycle events, sensors, inventory, reachability and command exit/status evidence
All transition mismatch, timeout, hang, blue-screen, device-loss, error and recovery records
Final power state, inventory/health comparison, protected-session audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and private DC-cycle script establish cold power cycling, while Procedure's generic `Run Reboot` is underspecified but not incompatible once the Project defines the supported chassis operation. The PSU-fan duplicate is separately identifiable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The power interface, semantics, timing and recovery are finite Project inputs. The intended cold off/on operation and criteria remain understandable, so readiness is conditional rather than irreducibly blocked.

review_improvement: Turns DeepSeek's unsafe raw power loop into a state-verified, secret-safe 25-cycle cold-power review with exact domain boundaries and evidence for every boot and device-retention claim.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful power command return is not proof that the chassis reached the intended electrical state. Cold-cycle coverage depends on observing the off boundary, waiting the approved dwell and demonstrating a clean full reinitialization; missing any checkpoint can turn 25 requested commands into fewer or ambiguous cycles.
